facts.fact: EcoCash launched an outbound international money transfer service from Zimbabwe to bank accounts and mobile wallets in countries including South Africa, Zambia, Kenya (M-Pesa) and China (Alipay), with all South African banks activated, per the company statement reported by NewsDay.

facts.fact: NewsDay describes EcoCash as Zimbabwe's largest fintech platform whose customers can now send money abroad directly from their EcoCash wallet to bank accounts or mobile wallets.
